diagnosis.root_cause: The subscriber's CATV service is provisioned and the ONU is online, but CATV synchronization is absent (catv_synced=0). Internet service, EPON optics, authentication, VLAN assignment, OLT, router, and shared PON operation are all healthy, pointing to a customer-side CATV/RF path or CATV frequency/level alignment fault.
evidence: The complaint is limited to TV: Internet service is working normally.
The subscriber has CATV service enabled, has_catv=1, and uses a CATV-capable ONU, but catv_synced=0.
The ONU is online with current RX power -20.4 dBm and TX power 2.45 dBm, both within the calibrated healthy ranges.
Seven days of RX and TX telemetry are stable; distance is constant at 118 and TX bias remains healthy, ruling out fibre degradation, laser degradation, and distance change.
All tested peers on EPON0/7 are online and healthy, so there is no PON-port, splitter, or shared infrastructure fault.
The OLT responds to ping and SNMP, has normal CPU, memory, and temperature, and all eight PONs are healthy.
The router heartbeat is healthy and traffic is passing, ruling out router reachability or general access failure.
RADIUS exists, matches CRM, and the subscriber has only two sessions in 24 hours with normal-duration sessions, ruling out missing, suspended, conflicting, replicated, or flapping authentication.
The customer VLAN is present and matches the expected VLAN 1037, ruling out the unprovisioned VLAN 46 condition.
The remaining evidence-specific fault is loss of CATV synchronization on this individual subscriber's CATV/RF path, best classified as catv_drift.

remediation.action: Inspect the ONU CATV/RF output, coaxial cabling, connectors, splitter, and television tuner; measure RF optical/CATV level and verify the CATV wavelength and frequency plan. Reapply or reprovision the CATV profile if required, then rescan channels and confirm catv_synced becomes true. Escalate to field service if the RF level or physical coax path is defective.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
